extraction_notes: The supplied PDF has no stated revision; the title and page references were transcribed from the document.
The SS34-MS column is grouped with SS32-MS for the 0.55 V maximum forward-voltage value and 500 pF typical junction-capacitance value on p. 2.

Curve points were manually digitized from real p. 3 plots only: Fig. 3 SS32-SS34, Fig. 4 TJ=25 degC, and Fig. 5 SS32-SS34. No interpolation was added; plotted mA and pF values were converted to A and F.
The p. 2 ratings table gives VRRM = 40 V, VRMS = 28 V, VDC = 40 V, IF(AV) = 3.0 A, and IFSM = 100.0 A for SS34-MS.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time or breakdown-voltage/current specification for this part.
